step1.title: Produce
step1.help: First choose a crop category (e.g. Vegetables), then tap the specific crop you want to sell from the list.
step1.heading: What would you like to sell?

A.title: Market Grade A (Fresh Premium)
A.text: Flawless appearance, uniform size, firm texture, zero blemishes. Best suited for supermarket retail.

B.title: Grade B (Commercial / Processing)
B.text: Slight cosmetic blemishes or skin color variations. Firm texture. Ideal for restaurant prep & bulk kitchens.

C.title: Grade C (Ripe / Processing Grade)
C.text: Softer texture or irregular shapes. Best suited for paste, juices, purées, and sauces.

step2.title: Batch & Quantity Details
step2.help: Specify your total supply quantity (type directly or use stepper), minimum order quantity (MOQ), crop variety, quality grade, and packaging parameters.
step2.quantityError: Please enter a supply quantity greater than 0.

step3.title: Add Harvest Photos
step3.help: Attach clear photos of your harvest. Buyers look for clear photos taken in natural light.
step3.alertBody: Please attach both Wide shot and Close-up quality photos to proceed.
step3.sampleNote: The buttons below attach a sample photo so you can try the flow. Sample photos are not saved with your listing.

wide.title: 1. Field / Wide Harvest Shot
wide.desc: Stand 2-3 meters back from harvest pile or crate stack. Ensure natural sunlight is behind you so the whole yield is visible.

closeup.title: 2. Close-up Produce Quality
closeup.desc: Hold camera 20cm away from individual produce. Focus clearly on skin texture, color firmness, and fresh condition.

packaging.title: 3. Packaging / Crates
packaging.desc: Show produce neatly packed inside standard 25kg plastic crates, wooden boxes, or sacks ready for transport loading.

tips.sunBody: Shoot outdoors under daylight instead of dim indoor rooms.
tips.scaleBody: Place a 25kg crate next to produce for buyer scale context.
tips.filterBody: Buyers need authentic photos without artificial color editing.

step3.uploadNotBuilt: Photo upload is not built yet
step3.wideHint: Capture the entire crop pile, crates, or scale of harvest.
step3.closeupHint: Show skin color, firmness, texture & absence of rot.
step3.packagingHint: Show how produce is stacked or packed in crates.

step4.title: Set Asking Price
step4.help: The price range shown is a sample, not live market data. You choose your own price.
step4.invalidBody: Please enter a valid asking price per kg.
step4.openKeypad: Open keypad to edit asking price
step4.negotiationLabel: Let buyers offer their own price
step4.negotiationOn: Buyers can send you an offer. You can accept, decline or name another price.
step4.negotiationOff: Buyers can only order at your asking price.
step4.sampleNote: Example figures until real market prices are available. Not live data.

step5.title: Schedule Transport
step5.help: Tell buyers where the produce is, when it is ready, and whether you want to share transport with nearby farms or arrange your own.
step5.dateAlertBody: Enter the ready date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-09-25.
step5.gateHelp: Tap the map where a lorry should come. Optional — without it the driver sees the district only.
step5.gateUnset: Not set — drivers will see {{district}} district
step5.sharedNote: Share truck space with nearby farms going the same way.
step5.soloNote: Arrange your own vehicle from your farm gate.
step5.selectReady: Select when crop will be ready for pickup
step5.windowNote: The driver promises a time inside this, and you will see it before they arrive.
step5.moveCrop: How would you like to move your crop?
